svg.aria-label: claude-infrastructure — the Claude Code creature walking a looping landscape under drifting clouds
svg.title: claude-infrastructure
svg.desc: Two Sessions. The same night, but once per loop a second session walks in from the right, the two meet, both throw their arms up, and the newcomer carries on — the title happening rather than being described. One 240-second loop; the wordmark is legible at every instant and nothing passes behind it.
